post_text:
10 days. 10 dashboards.
Memphis to all 50 states.

This is the one I've been building toward.

Day 10 is a published research report — 10 original findings on American public education. One per day. Every number sourced. Every dashboard live.

Here's what 10 days of public data actually found:

→ Memphis absenteeism hit 30.2% — highest ever, 11.9pts above TN average
→ Memphis ACT scores fell 5 years straight — 3 in 4 below college-ready
→ 5 TN districts defy the pattern — policy matters more than poverty
→ Tennessee's gains are real but the equity gap widened in 3 subjects
→ Mississippi leads reading gains despite worst attendance — policy timing wins
→ Same poverty, 15-point graduation gap — how money is spent beats how much
→ US absenteeism still 60% above pre-pandemic levels nationally
→ Utah spends $8K and outperforms states spending $26K — efficiency is real
→ Cleveland and Detroit recovered from Memphis-level absenteeism — intervention works
→ Public education data is fully public, fully free, and almost nobody is looking at it

Until now.

---

All 10 dashboards are live. All data is free to download.
Built by one data analyst in Memphis with a laptop and public data.

Starting 3 miles from where I work.

📊 Full report + all 10 dashboards → link in first comment 👇
